'''2014 Philadelphia Premiere Matt Sokol DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Sokol]] at [[2014 Philadelphia Premiere Event]].

* '''Player:''' [[Matt Sokol]]
* '''Event:''' [[2014 Philadelphia Premiere Event]]
